513-3558-3661.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-3558-3661.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

1623-4132-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
1623-4132-8170.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Draining Whelk
When Draining Whelk enters, it triggers, exiling the creature spell cast in step 1 and causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1832-2034-7452.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-7452.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-2301-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-2301-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

240-2079-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-2079-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6097-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6097-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2059-4050-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4716-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4716-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

64-1987-2510.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
64-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
64-1987-2510.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-2510.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

129-955-1409-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3249-4647-5173-5256.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
5256-6972-7325.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-7175.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3062-5902-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent and Pir, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1742-1824-6896.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed or are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
1742-1824-6896.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Acererak, adding {B}.
Cast Acererak from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {B} due to Green Goblin.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers, causing you to return it from the battlefield to your hand and venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1462-1809-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-1809-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-1809-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

224-1046-6628.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
224-1046-6628.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

2615-3480-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-3480-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

2634-4973-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2634-4973-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2634-4910-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2634-4910-5211.description:
Activate Alchemist's Refuge's second ability by paying {G}{U} and tapping it,  allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4359-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
4359-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1339-5611.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
643-1339-5611.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate the Insect by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

282-1756-4705-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-1756-4705-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering Delina twice and Lightning Runner once.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Reservoir Walker that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Reservoir Walker token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E} and gain at least 3 life.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

396-2034-3000-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorn and Squirrel, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

579-1562-3995.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

987-2684-2724.notablePrerequisites: Shadow Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
987-2684-2724.description:
Tap Shadow Guildmage for {U} to put Wormfang Manta on top of your library.
Wormfang Manta's LTB triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Activate Mastery of the Unseen for {3}{W} to manifest Wormfang Manta.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn it face up.
Repeat for infinite turns.

2104-2493-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Archaeomancer.
2104-2493-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2145-4722.description: Erayo counters the first spell cast, and Ethersworn Canonist only lets opponent cast one non-artifact spell a turn.
